abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly provides a robot, a motion control method and device thereof and a storage medium. The robot motion control method comprises the steps of obtaining plantar force of a supporting leg when the robot moves, determining the deformation quantity of a leg elastic piece of the robot according to the plantar force, determining the knee joint compensation amount for robot mass center height compensation according to the deformation quantity, and controlling a knee joint motor of the robot according to the knee joint compensation amount. In the embodiment of the invention, the knee joint motor is subjected to compensation control through the deformation quantity of the leg elastic piece of the supporting leg of the robot, so that the control precision of the supporting leg is effectively improved, the problem of body height reduction caused by deformation of the supporting leg elastic piece in the walking process of the robot is eliminated or relieved, and the body height of the robot is kept constant; and the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.

A system, method, and device for generating Pepper's Ghost artifices from two-dimensional sources including Augmented Reality (“AR”) or Virtual Reality (“VR”) environments such that the Pepper's Ghost artifices appear to be a natural addition to a three-dimensional virtual environment. By employing virtual Pepper's Ghost projections onto varying size and shaped screens in the virtual three-dimensional environment, a reduction in bandwidth and costs are realized particularly when displaying humanoid characters in an AR and/or VR environment. While the methods disclosed with the present invention could be of utility to any type of virtual environment, the benefits are particularly acute for dynamic VR environments.

The invention provides a control method and device based on an emotion cumulative value, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of: determining a corresponding to-be-monitored event according to a current personality type of a robot, and monitoring whether the to-be-monitored event occurs or not, wherein the current personality type is from a to-be-selected personality type of the robot; and if monitoring that the to-be-monitored event occurs, according to the monitored to-be-monitored event and the current personality type, adjusting an emotion value of a corresponding emotion dimension in a plurality of emotion dimensions of the robot. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the influence of past events on emotions is fully reflected, so that the change of the emotions better fits the real emotions of human beings; and meanwhile, when the to-be-monitored event is determined and an emotion value is adjusted, the personality type of the robot is fully considered, so that the difference between events concerned by different people and the personalized difference between emotion change modes are reflected, and the authenticity of simulating the real human beings by the robot is effectively improved. Therefore, the robot can be more intelligent and humanoid.

The invention provides a humanoid robot reinforcement learning training method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a model file of a humanoid robot; analyzing the model file to obtain a position relation of two feet of the humanoid robot and part constraint information of the humanoid robot, and establishing a reference coordinate system according to the position relation of the two feet; according to the reference coordinate system and the component constraint information, a parallel ankle joint mechanism model of the humanoid robot is constructed, and inverse kinematics information is determined according to the parallel ankle joint mechanism model; and training a reinforcement learning strategy of the humanoid robot according to the inverse kinematics information and the component constraint information. According to the method, series-parallel connection conversion in a resolving mode in the training process is avoided, the operation efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the requirement for reinforcement learning parallel sampling efficiency is lowered, the training process is simplified, and the convergence speed of reinforcement learning strategies is increased.

A robotic arm system (1) for controlling the actions of a robotic arm (5), the system being provided with a ranking-determining unit (11) that determines the ranking of teaching information based on at least one of: perception information, which is information that a human (16) perceives concerning the environment around the robotic arm (5) and that the human uses to change the action of the robotic arm (5) by operating the robotic arm; reaction time information, which is time information from when the human (16) receives the perception information during operation of the robotic arm (5) until the human (16) operates the robotic arm (5); and variation information, which is information relating to the degree of variation in at least one of the teaching information or the perception information. Action information for the robotic arm (5) is generated from the teaching information and the ranking determined by the ranking-determining unit (11).

The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot non-grabbing type mobile pushing task control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building a system interaction force model based on the pose information of the interaction among a humanoid robot, a target object and an environment, and then building the dynamics models of the humanoid robot and the target object; establishing a system speed constraint model and a system force constraint model based on speed and force constraint conditions satisfied by pairwise interaction among the humanoid robot, the target object and the environment; robot joint angular acceleration constraint conditions are obtained according to the established system speed constraint model, the established system force constraint model and the dynamical models of the humanoid robot and the target object; and obtaining a system motion boundary condition based on the established robot joint angular acceleration constraint condition, and executing a non-grabbing type mobile operation task according to the condition that the motion trail of the humanoid robot meets the system motion boundary condition.

A humanoid robot has mobility, has many freedom degrees, comprises two arms, a neck, a waist, two legs and the like, and can complete more complex tasks. If these joints need to be connected togetherand subjected to unified coordination control, higher requirements for reliability and real-time performance of a control system are put forward. The invention provides a robot joint servo control system comprising a central controller and a joint controller. The joint controller comprises a controller shell and a controller circuit board. The top face of the controller shell is fixed to a rectangular shell through screws. Installation parts are arranged at the positions of the four corners of the bottom face of the rectangular shell correspondingly. Aviation plugs are arranged on the two opposite side faces of the rectangular shell correspondingly. The controller circuit board is located in the rectangular shell. Special conditioning circuits are designed in lvdt displacement sensor connectors and force sensor connectors. Meanwhile, excitation signal circuits matched with the corresponding conditioning circuits are further arranged in the force sensor connectors.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot head which comprises a humanoid robot body, the humanoid robot comprises eyes, ears, a nose and mouth organs of the face, and the humanoid robot further comprises a face blinking transmission mechanism which comprises silica gel eyelids and a controller for driving the eyelids to move up and down; the eye driving mechanism comprises a rotating eyeball mechanism and a columnar shell, the columnar shell is connected with an eye hemisphere through an eye body, the inner side of the eyeball mechanism comprises a camera device, the columnar shell comprises a first control device and a second control device, eyeballs are controlled to rotate all around, and meanwhile the structure is compact, the control precision is high, friction is small, and the response speed is high. According to the humanoid robot head, through the corresponding design of the traction rope, the first control device, the second control device, the camera, the motor and the like, rotation of the eyes of the robot in the up-down direction, the left-right direction and the like can be achieved, good control can be achieved, the structure is compact, and practicability is high.

A robot arm of a wafer transfer apparatus is provided to perform smoothly a wafer absorbing process regardless of the damage of a wafer support unit by using an improved arrangement of a first exhaust line. A robot arm of a wafer transfer apparatus includes a blade, a wafer support unit, a first exhaust line and a second exhaust line. The blade(112) is used for supporting a wafer. The wafer support unit(114) is installed on the blade. The wafer support unit has at least one vacuum hole(115). The exhaust line(122) is installed under the wafer support unit. The first exhaust line is connected through the vacuum hole of the wafer support unit. The second exhaust line(124) is used for connecting the first exhaust line to a vacuum pump. The wafer support unit includes a wafer support region(114a) and an edge region(114b). The first exhaust line is installed under a predetermined portion of the wafer support region, wherein the predetermined portion is spaced apart from the edge region.

The embodiment of the invention provides a control method and device of a humanoid robot, the robot and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that after the whole body state of the humanoid robot is updated, the target position of an operation object in whole body reachability space information of the humanoid robot is acquired; determining a target motion mode according to the target position and the reachability subspace information of each movable part; according to the target motion mode, the target movable part is controlled to execute the target operation, efficient decision making is conducted on the motion modes of the humanoid robot, the ability of the humanoid robot to flexibly switch the motion modes in the factory environment is improved, and the control accuracy of the humanoid robot is improved.

A system and method of object manipulation and training including providing at least one robotic hand including a plurality of grippers connected to a body and providing a plurality of cameras disposed in a periphery surface of the grippers. The method also includes providing a plurality of tactile sensors disposed in the periphery surface of the grippers and actuating the grippers to grasp an object. The method further includes detecting a position of the object with respect to the robotic hand via a first image feed from the tactile sensors and detecting a position of the object with respect to the robotic hand via a second image feed from the cameras. The method also includes generating instructions to grip and manipulate an orientation of the object based on the first and the second image feeds for a visualization of the object relative to the robotic hand.

The invention provides a path planning method, an amphibious unmanned platform, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of path planning, and the path planning method based on the amphibious unmanned platform comprises the steps: obtaining amphibious environment data; inputting the amphibious environment data into the target planning model to obtain a planning path output by the target planning model; wherein the target planning model is obtained by training a PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning, and the PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning is obtained after batch dominant function regularization, strategy entropy introduction and adaptive adjustment of cutting factors. Through the above mode, the PPO algorithm based on reinforcement learning is adopted to provide path planning for the amphibious unmanned platform, and improvements of batch dominant function regularization, strategy entropy introduction and adaptive adjustment of cutting factors are performed on the algorithm and the strategy, so that the obstacle avoidance capability in an amphibious environment is improved, and the safety is improved.

The invention discloses a humanoid piano playing robot which can comprise paws, arms, a waist, a neck, legs, a control system and a base, the neck corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, the waist corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, and the legs correspond to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch. According to the humanoid piano playing robot, the positions of the keys can be accurately positioned through the visual perception unit, the content of a music score can be intelligently recognized, and piano playing can be automatically carried out according to the music score. Through the two degrees of freedom of the waist and the head and control over the poses of the two mechanical arms, the piano playing robot in the specification can play a piano skillfully and intelligently.

The embodiment of the invention discloses a human-robot interaction method and device. The method comprises the steps that the interaction situation where a robot is located is monitored, and whether the interaction situation is matched with a current interaction situation set by the robot is judged; if the interaction situation where the robot is located is matched with the current interaction situation set by the robot, the robot is controlled to display an interaction expression corresponding to the current interaction situation; and if the interaction situation where the robot is located is not matched with the current interaction situation set by the robot, the current interaction situation of the robot is set to be the monitored interaction situation, and the robot is controlled to display an interaction expression corresponding to the monitored interaction situation. According to the human-robot interaction method and device, the device can respond according to the emotive information of an interaction object and generate an affectional resonance for the interaction object when communicates and interacts with the interaction object, the human-robot interaction effect is improved, and the user experience is improved.

The invention provides a folding type industrial robot and relates to the technical field of industrial machinery. The folding type industrial robot comprises a rack. A hydraulic tank is fixedly arranged on the top of the rack. A hydraulic device is fixedly arranged on the top of the rack through a mounting frame. The hydraulic device comprises a push rod motor. The output end of the push rod motor is movably connected with a hollow shaft lever. The output end of the push rod motor is movably connected with a push spring. A first push rod is fixedly arranged at the end, far away from the motor, of the push spring. The upper and lower sides of the inner wall of the hollow shaft lever are both provided with slide rails. The first push rod is slidably connected with the corresponding slide rail. The folding type industrial robot can conduct rising and dropping. The working efficiency is improved. Mechanical operation is more convenient, easier and more reasonable. Accordingly, the robot achieves the folding effect and is suitable for various heights of operation during work. Manpower and material resources are saved. The robot can be stored in a smaller space.

The present invention provides a humanoid robot hand that is improved so that the motion of flexing and extending the finger joints of the robot hand resembles the motion of actual muscles. The robot hand of the present invention comprises a palm plate (1) on which a thumb (2), an index finger (3), a middle finger (4), a ring finger (5), and a little finger (6) are arranged at predetermined positions. The thumb (2), index finger (3), middle finger (4), ring finger (5), and little finger (6) are each formed by a finger assembly (7). Furthermore, the long joint frame (8), the middle joint frame (9), and the short joint frame (10) of the finger assembly (7) are axially connected by first to third central two-row pulleys (12), (14), and (16), which are axially supported by first to third pivot axes (13), (15), and (17).

A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. Said head portion includes: a frontal shell having a rear edge, a rear shell having a frontal edge, and an electronics assembly. The electronics assembly includes various components and devices used in the operation of the humanoid robot.

PURPOSE: A real-time humanoid control system and a control method thereof are provided to easily and freely control a humanoid using an upper body exoskeleton robot. CONSTITUTION: A real-time humanoid control system comprises an upper body exoskeleton robot(10) and a humanoid device(20). The upper body exoskeleton robot measures information about the rotational angle of each joint of an upper body through multiple sensors(11,12) and estimates the movement of the joints of the upper body using the measured information. The upper body exoskeleton robot transmits a lower body control signal matching the estimated movement to the humanoid device. The humanoid device powers the joints of the lower body depending on the transmitted lower body control signal.

The invention discloses an extensible robot humanoid precise grabbing skill learning method and system, and relates to the crossing field of artificial intelligence and robotology, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the grabbing motion track of a robot imitation demonstrator; a robot grabbing skill model is established according to the grabbing motion trail of the simulation demonstrator; learning and optimizing parameters of the robot grabbing skill model to obtain a grabbing reference track guided by experience knowledge of the demonstrator; the grabbing reference track is converted into a linear dynamic system, and parameter optimization is conducted on the linear dynamic system so that global convergence of the robot grabbing skill can be achieved; and reconstructing the robot grabbing skill model by using the intermediate point so as to realize rapid expansion of the robot grabbing skill. According to the method, the problems of poor expansibility and low accuracy in a robot grabbing path planning process in an unstructured environment can be solved.

The invention discloses an intelligent data processing method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the analysis and processing of various external sound data based on a data processing terminal, and determining a plurality of groups of sound instructions; and based on the data processing terminal, performing priority analysis on the multiple groups of sound instructions, and determining a priority sound instruction set. According to the method, sound data of the surrounding environment of the humanoid robot is collected through an auditory sensor, then semantic analysis, instruction priority analysis, instruction completion degree analysis, energy demand analysis and instruction recheck processing are performed on the sound data, and whether the humanoid robot executes a first execution sound instruction or not is determined; according to the mode, the problem that the humanoid robot cannot perfectly complete the instruction can be avoided, the problem that the instruction cannot be completely completed due to insufficient energy can also be avoided, in addition, the instruction is rechecked, the problem of energy waste of the humanoid robot caused by mistaken instruction sending can also be avoided, and the cost is indirectly reduced.

A system for installing a solar panel may include a first end-of-arm assembly tool coupled to a first robotic arm and part of a first assembly robot and a second end-of-arm assembly tool coupled to a second robotic arm and part of a second assembly robot. The first and the second end-of-arm assembly tools have different tooling and perform different functions to assembly solar panels to support structure. The first assembly robot and the second assembly robot may be located on autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles and the various components can be operated by a control system based on operation instructions received from a neural network.

The invention discloses a labyrinth feature recognition and walking method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the specific steps that step 1, a camera at the head of the humanoid robot collectsan image; step 2, the humanoid robot performs image processing and image feature extraction on collected image information, wherein the processes include edge detection, circle detection, straight line detection and line splicing to identify the features of the labyrinth; step 3, the humanoid robot identifies intersection types according to the features of the labyrinth; and step 4, the humanoidrobot passes through the current intersection according to the intersection types and walking strategies. The method uses vision, sonar and information of fewer markers, obtains the relative positioninformation of the robot in the labyrinth, identifies the intersection types in the labyrinth and develops corresponding walking strategies according to different intersection types to make the humanoid robot successfully pass the intersections, realize the labyrinth navigation and realize the direction calibration when deviation occurs during the walking.

The invention relates to a virtual reality technology-based humanoid robot remote control system and method, the system comprises a VR device and a humanoid robot, and the VR device comprises a head-mounted device, a hand device, a visual information sampling unit, a hand device sampling unit and a visual information imaging unit; the humanoid robot comprises a robot system communication unit, a robot system planning control unit, a visual sensor and a joint motor execution unit. The technical problems that existing robot control mainly depends on field teaching operation of workers, so that the mechanical arm control threshold is high, and the field limitation is large are solved, and the beneficial effects of being low in threshold, high in interactivity, low in delay, high in safety, high in flexibility and the like are achieved.

A robotic assistance device includes a robotic arm configured assist a human being and one or more sensors configured to receive input data. The input data includes information related to one or more activities being performed by the human being. The robotic assistance device further includes a processor operatively connected to the one or more sensors and the first robotic arm. The processor is configured to process data received from the sensor, and to determine, based on the processed data, that a task should be performed by the robotic assistance device based at least in part on the activities being performed by the human being. The processor is further configured cause the operative piece to perform the task.

The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom mechanical leg for a legged robot based on a self-locking worm and gear transmission pair, which comprises a thigh part and a shank part which are hinged through a knee pivot, and further comprises a transmission mechanism, and the transmission mechanism comprises a transmission rod and a connecting rod; the connecting rod is provided with a first end part hinged to the transmission rod through a connecting shaft I and a second end part hinged to the shank part through a connecting shaft II; the thigh part and the transmission rod are positioned on the same side of the shank part; the axis of the connecting shaft I, the axis of the connecting shaft II and the axis of the knee pivot shaft are parallel; the transmission rod is driven to be close to or far away from the knee pivot through the first transmission pair, so that the shank part is driven by the transmission rod to swing around the knee pivot through the connecting rod; the transmission mechanism further comprises a second transmission pair used for driving the thigh part to rotate in the set direction. Under the condition that the structure is simple, the large and accurate transmission ratio between the thighs and the shanks is met, the bearing capacity and the transmission efficiency are improved, and meanwhile, the bionic robot has the function of rotating in the set direction and better conforms to bionics.

The invention discloses a precision-operation truss robot based on force feedback and a control method thereof. The precision-operation truss robot comprises a truss, a suspension arm and a clamping manipulator, wherein the truss is fixedly arranged on the ground and provided with a movable suspension beam, the axial direction of the suspension beam is a first direction, and the suspension beam can move in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction; the suspension arm is movably arranged on the suspension beam and is telescopic; the clamping manipulator is arranged at the lower end of the suspension arm and comprises a fixed clamping plate, a movable clamping plate and a drive mechanism, the fixed clamping plate is vertically fixed, the drive mechanism is arranged opposite to the fixed clamping plate, the movable clamping plate is arranged on the drive mechanism, is parallel to the fixed clamping plate and is driven by the drive mechanism to approach to or depart from the fixed clamping plate; and a pressure sensor is arranged on the movable clamping plate, and a distance sensor facing downwards is arranged on the movable clamping plate. By adoption of the precision-operation truss robot based on force feedback and the control method thereof, it is guaranteed that vulnerable objects in irregular shapes are safely grabbed and carried to the maximum extent.

The invention discloses a fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand comprises variable-rigidity flexible fingers, a palm body, a palm cover, an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, and mounting holes in the variable-rigidity flexible fingers are correspondingly mounted in the upper end face and mounting groove holes of the palm body; the electric control unit and the six-way combined fluid valve are arranged in a cavity of the palm body side by side, and the palm cover is fixedly connected with the palm body. According to the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, the multi-section sub-control type design is adopted, a plurality of electric control fluid micro-valves are arranged in the flexible finger bodies, and independent control over the flexible finger joints is achieved; a rigidity adjusting layer is arranged, so that the object grasping stability of the flexible hand is further improved; an electromechanical integration mode is adopted, the palm body internally comprises an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, the constraint of redundant cables is reduced, and the working efficiency is further improved.

The invention relates to an information processing method and device, head-mounted equipment and a medium, the information processing method is applied to the head-mounted equipment, the method comprises the steps that at least one frame of face image is acquired, the face image comprises an eyebrow image and an eye image, the eyebrow image is acquired by an eyebrow tracking camera, and the eye image is acquired by an eye tracking camera; determining expression information of the user based on the facial image and an expression detection network; and obtaining and displaying an anthropomorphic image, wherein the expression of the anthropomorphic image is related to the expression information. The head-mounted device is provided with the eyebrow tracking camera and the eye tracking camera, it is guaranteed that even if the position and distance between the head-mounted device and the face of the user are changed, the complete face image of the user can be obtained, the eye tracking robustness of the user is effectively improved, and the user experience is improved. The anthropomorphic image generated based on the expression information realizes the real simulation of the expression of the user, enhances the interestingness and vividness of display, and improves the use experience of the user.

The invention discloses a three-freedom-degree series-connection low-frequency mechanical humanoid robot foot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots.The foot comprises a mechanical shank, a tarsal bone, a metatarsal bone, toes, a metatarsal skeleton, an arch-shaped foot sole, an instep plate, an ankle shaft, a tarsal shaft and a toe shaft; the two ends of the tarsal bone are each provided with a notch and connected with the metatarsal bone and the mechanical shank through the tarsal shaft and the ankle shaft respectively; a thin plate with a certain radian is adopted as the arch-shaped foot sole, the arch-shaped foot sole is installed at the bottom of the metatarsal skeleton, and the instep plate is installed on the top of the metatarsal skeleton; the metatarsal bone is installed on the metatarsal skeleton and connected with the toes in a hinged mode through the toe shaft; the ankle shaft, the tarsal shaft and the toe shaft are installed in parallel.The humanoid robot foot is reasonable in structure, has three freedom degrees and the low-frequency characteristic and is in a series mode.

The invention provides a robot facial expression control mechanism and a robot comprising same. The robot facial expression control mechanism comprises a humanoid skull shell, a humanoid silicone skin, a lip motion control mechanism and at least one eyebrow motion control mechanism; each eyebrow motion control mechanism comprises a first mounting substrate, a first power output component and a first transmission component; each first power output assembly drives the corresponding first transmission component to move; the first transmission components penetrate through eyebrow track grooves andare connected with eyebrow portions of the humanoid silicone skin; the lip motion control mechanism comprises a second mounting substrate, a second power output component and a second transmission component; the second power output component drives the second transmission component to move; and the second transmission component penetrates through a lip track groove and is connected with the lip portion of the humanoid silicone skin. By applying the technical scheme, the problem that in the prior art, robot expression control mechanisms are bulky, and other functions of robots are limited canbe solved.

The invention belongs to the technical field of control, particularly relates to a musculoskeletal system control method and system based on speed precision balance and a device, and aims to solve the problem that an existing humanoid musculoskeletal robot control method cannot well perform antagonistic muscle collaborative contraction control. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring estimated motion precision of a musculoskeletal system through a Fitts' law; calculating a supervised item torque based on the estimated motion precision through a striatum inspired speed modulation strategy; calculating a muscle activation signal vector through a muscle activation signal network; and calculating an action award based on the muscle activation signal vector and the supervised item torque, then calculating a loss function, adjusting parameters of the muscle activation signal network based on the loss function, increasing the value of the action reward, and repeatedly iterating to obtain a muscle activation signal sequence required by control. According to the method, structural information of the musculoskeletal system is utilized, a universal antagonistic muscle cooperative contraction control strategy is constructed, and smooth movement is guaranteed.

The invention discloses a robotic arm wrist joint, and belongs to the technical field of modular joints. The robotic arm wrist joint comprises a shell, a flexible wheel output shaft, a motor shaft anda split harmonic reducer, wherein the split harmonic reducer comprises a steel wheel, a flexible wheel and a wave generator; the steel wheel is in fastened connection with the shell; the flexible wheel is in fastened connection with the flexible wheel output shaft; a positioning hole is formed in the center of the motor shaft; the wave generator comprises a first end and a second end; the first end is embedded in the positioning hole and is fit with the inner wall of the motor shaft; the second end is arranged on the end surface of the motor shaft, and is in fastened connection with the motorshaft; a central hole for wiring is formed in the center of the wave generator. The overall weight and volume of the robotic arm wrist joint can be obviously reduced under the condition of ensuring torque.

An autonomous humanoid robot configured to overcome limited maneuvering issues by offering a more efficient autonomous humanoid robot that autonomously operates to interact with users and interact with other robots, and includes a computing system configured to provide instruction and programming for estimating and controlling pivotal movement of body components involving arms, legs and a waist module which are configured to support the body and reposition the body such that the autonomous humanoid robot can step, walk, roll or skate or perform various handling maneuvers to complete tasks.

The invention discloses a robot finger device of a connecting rod gear sliding groove with a linear parallel grabbing function, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The device comprisesa base, a motor, a transmission mechanism, a first transmission wheel, a second transmission wheel, a connecting rod, a first finger section, a second finger section, a near-joint shaft, a far-joint shaft, a first shaft, a second shaft, a third shaft, a fourth shaft and a fifth shaft. According to the device, the function of linear parallel clamping of the robot finger is achieved; when the objectis clamped by the device, the second finger section always keeps a rectilinear motion trail, the second finger section can move with a linear parallel to grab the object, and the device is suitable for being used for grabbing a thin-plate-shaped object on a workbench; the device is large in grabbing range; two finger sections are driven by a driver, the driving mode is simple, and a complicated sensing and control system is not needed; and the device is compact in structure, small in size, low in manufacturing and maintaining cost, and the device is suitable for the robot hand.

The invention provides a robot trajectory planning method based on a fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and a humanoid robot platform. Through the method, specific movements required by various joints are planned, a complete trajectory generation control system is established, and stable control on a humanoid robot under a ZMP stable condition is ensured. The trajectory planning part of the method comprises the steps of construction of a B-spline function, mathematical model deduction of the B-spline function, solution of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and densification of a joint trajectory. After an expected trajectory is derived, corresponding movement functions are edited to a raspberry Pi system according to to-be-solved data points, corresponding instructions are sent through smartphone application software to call the corresponding movement functions to complete the expected planning trajectory. With the adoption of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function for planning the movement trajectory, no sharp corner problem is caused at places between adjacent joints, vibration of a joint mechanical arm is avoided, and the stability of the humanoid robot in a movement process is improved.

The invention discloses a method for real-time simulation of human motion through anthropomorphic robot based on multiple working chains. The method for real-time simulation of human motion through anthropomorphic robot based on multiple working chains comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and optimization; S2, coordinate mapping; S3, forward kinematic model establishment; S4, reverse kinematics solving of the multiple working chains; S5, filtering processing of angle values; and S6, angle value limiting..The real-time humanoid robot simulation method absorbs advantages of existing various technologies, realizes real-time imitation of the human body motion through the anthropomorphic robot, and has high application and promotion value.

An apparatus and method for adaptive handling of slides using a robot arm. The apparatus includes at least a computing device comprised of a processor and a memory communicatively connected to the processor. The memory instructs the processor to receive a calibration procedure, wherein the calibration procedure is generated using a plurality of waypoints. The processor controls the at least a robotic arm as a function of the calibration procedure, wherein the calibration procedure is configured to cause the robotic arm to pick, using a pick waypoint of the plurality of waypoints, and place, using a place waypoint of the plurality of waypoints, a slide. The processor receives a plurality of feedback from the at least a robotic arm. The processor generates, using the plurality of feedback, an adapted pick waypoint. The memory instructs the processor to generate, using the plurality of feedback, an adapted place waypoint.

The invention discloses a multi-information map navigation method for a legged robot based on field terrain type and physical characteristic visual inference, and relates to the technical field of map navigation. The invention aims to solve the problem of low accuracy of the existing field environment map navigation method of the foot-type robot. The method comprises the following steps: inputting an RGB image of a to-be-detected area into Fast-TerrienNet to obtain a terrain of the to-be-detected area, and obtaining a rigidity grade and a friction grade of the terrain of the to-be-detected area; utilizing the depth image of the to-be-detected area to obtain the pose of the foot-type robot; constructing a three-dimensional diagram of the to-be-detected area by using the terrain in the to-be-detected area, the rigidity grade and the friction grade of the terrain in the to-be-detected area, the depth image of the to-be-detected area and the pose information of the foot robot; projecting the three-dimensional diagram of the to-be-measured area to a horizontal plane by taking a preset height threshold value as a constraint, and then setting an impassable area based on a terrain type, a rigidity level and a friction level so as to obtain a final two-dimensional navigation map; and deploying the final two-dimensional navigation map into a Ros Native Stack (Region Navigation Stack). The method is used for field navigation of the multi-legged robot.

The present invention relates to a finger module and a robot hand using the same. The finger module according to the present invention comprises: a contact roller; a roller driving unit which rotates the contact roller with respect to the rotation axis of the contact roller; and a roller steering unit which controls an angle of the rotation axis of the contact roller. Therefore, the robot hand efficiently rotates an object to be sewed through a simple configuration.

The invention provides a coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting idle stroke and transmission flexible pieces and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces comprises a base, two finger segments, two joint shafts, a driver, two transmission wheels, the two flexible pieces, a transition transmission mechanism, a middle transmission mechanism, a shift wheel, a lug drive plate, a limiting drive plate, two spring pieces and a limiting lug. According to the coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces, through the idle stroke between a driving lug on the shift wheel and a driven lug on the lug drive plate, a coupling and self-adapting composite grabbing manner is achieved; two joints can be in linkage to pinch an object, the purpose that the first finger segment is rotated and then the second finger segment is rotated to hold an object can also be achieved, and therefore the self-adapting grabbing effect on objects in different shapes and sizes can be achieved; only the one driver is used for driving the two joints, and a complicated sensing and real-time control system is not needed; and the coupling and self-adapting robot finger device adopting the idle stroke and the transmission flexible pieces is simple in structure, small in volume, light in weight and low in cost.

The invention relates to the technical field of cognitive modeling, in particular to an anthropomorphic agent framework and method based on a cognitive triangle psychological mechanism. Comprising the steps that a psychological mechanism agent is designed, specifically, a frame based on cognitive triangles is designed, emotion, thinking and behaviors interact, and a cognitive behavior structure of the agent is formed; the emotion module introduces a hierarchical emotion model, and the thinking module introduces a triple network model and reconstructs an existing agent framework. Compared with previous research, the method simulates more real agent emotion and thinking, and makes a contribution to human-like behavior simulation.

The invention discloses a force feedback exoskeleton and a humanoid robot imitation learning method. The force feedback exoskeleton comprises a bearing part, an arm exoskeleton part and a data glove part. The number of the arm exoskeleton parts is two, the two arm exoskeleton parts are symmetrically connected to the backpack part, and the number of the data glove parts is two so as to collect position and posture information of the left hand and the right hand respectively. The humanoid robot imitation learning method is based on same double-arm characteristics and operator visual angle image input, is combined with nodal topology correlation organization of human joints, integrates multi-modal data information, and outputs control quantity which is almost the same as expert operation. The system is applied to the technical field of exoskeletons, high-quality data acquisition can be realized while the exoskeleton is lightweight and integrated, the number of degrees of freedom of data acquisition of traditional exoskeletons is greatly increased, and the system can be used for guiding collaborative movement of double mechanical arms and further effectively applied to flexible operation tasks of humanoid robots.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control. The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system, a medium, a product and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: taking a forward observation point of a humanoid robot as a centroid projection expected pose, obtaining the slope of the forward observation point according to the difference value between the centroid projection expected pose and the centroid projection actual pose, and calculating the motion of the humanoid robot. The forward linear speed of the humanoid robot is obtained according to the slope of the forward observation point, and the humanoid robot is controlled according to the forward linear speed to reach the position of the forward observation point; according to the method, an off-line track library does not need to be established, online control is achieved, the calculated amount is small, the requirement for calculation power is low, the influence of modeling errors of a motion model on robot control is reduced, the pose of the robot can be controlled more accurately, and the control precision and stability are improved.

The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot obstacle avoidance method based on model prediction control. Scanning a road in front of the humanoid robot through a laser scanner arranged at the head of the humanoid robot, forming a coordinate point cloud according to a scanning result, and drawing a terrain map of the road in front of the humanoid robot; the height of the obstacle is calculated through a depth camera arranged on the humanoid robot part; and when the height of the obstacle is smaller than the leg length of the humanoid robot, the humanoid robot is controlled to walk to the front of the obstacle, and upside-down overturning obstacle crossing operation is executed. According to the method, a forward upside-down obstacle crossing mode is combined with a model-based prediction algorithm, so that the working efficiency and the stability are improved while a specific environment task can be completed, and the application prospect is wide.

A surgical robotic arm support system may include a base and at least one post and/or a connection for coupling a robot arm to the support system. The base may be configured to at least partially surround a surgical table. The at least one post may have a first end supported on the base and a second end configured to support a robotic arm. The at least one post may be configured to be coupled to a surgical table. The connection may support a mechanical and/or electrical connectivity between the support system and a coupled robot arm. Electrical connectivity may be configured to identify at least one of the robot arm connections to which at least one robot arm is connected. Each robot arm connection may be configured to maintain a portion of a connected robot arm at a predetermined position from the base.

The invention relates to an anthropomorphic work order alarm system based on a voice instruction matching technology, and aims to improve work order processing efficiency and user experience. The system can receive and analyze a voice instruction of a user in real time through an advanced voice recognition technology, automatically generate a work order and carry out intelligent alarm. And the personification design enables the system to carry out natural conversation with the user and provide personalized services. The system not only can reduce the complexity of manual operation, but also can improve the response speed, is helpful for handling emergencies in time, and is suitable for work order management and alarm requirements of various industries.

The invention discloses a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm balance control system loaded on a robot dog. The system comprises a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm dynamic balance control signal matching module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm dynamic balance step determining module, a different-axial-direction dynamic calling module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm balance parameter formulating module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm robot dog demand affirming module and a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm operation optimizing module. The system comprises a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm monitoring platform, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm monitoring platform coordination management module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm data management module, a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm using module and a six-axis intelligent mechanical arm robot dog PID instruction circulation module. According to the system provided by the invention, the dynamic calling control program of the dynamic balance control signal instruction of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm is defined through the machine specification, so that the missing report rate and the false report rate of dynamic calling supervision of the dynamic balance control signal instruction of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm are reduced, the labor cost is reduced, and the efficiency of the six-axis intelligent mechanical arm is improved.

An autonomous floor cleaner includes multiple occupiable space sensors for position and/or proximity sensing. Data from the occupiable space sensors can be used determine areas of occupiable space in proximity to the autonomous floor cleaner. Methods for exiting a trapped condition, obstacle avoidance, and path planning are disclosed.

A method for use with an industrial robot comprises: searching a plurality of first possible positions of the industrial robot within a first area with a first searching step, wherein the industrial robot is configured to operate at the plurality of first possible positions; obtaining a performance parameter of the industrial robot at each of the plurality of first possible positions, the performance parameter being indicative to evaluate the performance of the industrial robot; searching a plurality of second possible positions of the industrial robot within a second area with a second searching step based on the performance parameter at each of the plurality of first possible positions, wherein the second searching step is smaller than the first searching step and the second area is within the first area; and presenting the performance parameter of the industrial robot at each of the plurality of the first and/or second possible positions. The user may determine the optimal tool assembly direction in a convenient way.

This specification describes an adaptive robotic nursing assistant for physical tasks and patient observation and feedback. In some examples, the adaptive robotic nursing assistant includes an omni-directional mobile platform; a footrest on the omni-directional mobile platform; a handlebar located above the footrest such that a user standing on the footrest can grasp the handlebar; a display above the handlebar and at least one user input device; a robot manipulator comprising a robotic arm and an end effector on the robotic arm; and a control system coupled to the omni-directional mobile platform, the control system comprising at least one processor and memory storing executable instructions for the at least one processor to control the omni-directional mobile platform.

The invention discloses an anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet. The anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet comprises a trunk skeleton, a waist, a right leg and a left leg; the waist is connected with the trunk skeleton through a waist rotating platform; the left side and the right side of the waist are connected with the left leg and the right legthrough double-degree-of-freedom hip joints; the lower part of the trunk skeleton is fixedly connected with the waist rotating platform of the waist; a waist rotating mechanism drives the waist rotating platform to rotate so as to drive the trunk skeleton to rotate around a Z axis and realize Z-axis rotation freedom degree of the waist; an X-axis driving motor of the hip joint drives a hip jointball through a hip joint straight gear group to rotate around the X axis to realize the X-axis rotation freedom degree of the hip joint; a Y-axis driving motor realizes vertical reversing from X-axisrotation to Y-axis rotation through a bevel gear pair; and a planetary wheel speed-reducing mechanism drives a tail end connecting flange to rotate around the Y axis to realize Y-axis rotation freedomdegree of the hip joint. The 13 degrees of freedom enable the upright walking posture of the robot to imitate the action of human beings.

A robotic device for operation in association with an appendage of a user, wherein the appendage of the user has an endpoint, the robotic device comprising: a base; and a robotic arm attached to the base and having an endpoint, the robotic arm having at least two active degrees of freedom relative to the base and being configured so that when the base is appropriately positioned relative to a user, the reference frame of the robotic device is oriented generally similarly to the reference frame of the user and motions of the endpoint of the appendage of the user are mimicked by motions of the endpoint of the robotic arm.

The invention provides a novel biped humanoid robot system based on pneumatic artificial muscles, belongs to the technical field of robots, and in particular relates to a biped robot having powerful athletic ability and flexible humanoid characteristics. The biped humanoid robot system comprises a mechanical body and an electrical control system; the biped humanoid robot system is characterized in that the mechanical body is mainly composed of seven parts, namely a waist, a hip joint, thighs, knee joints, shanks, feet and the like, and has 13 degrees of freedom in total; in the 13 degrees of freedom, 3 degrees of freedom of the waist are realized by virtue of the cooperation of four pneumatic muscles and the waist spine, and the single degree of freedom of each of the hip joint, the knee joints and the ankle joints is realized by use of one pneumatic muscle and one spring which are pulled to each other to produce opposed rotating force. According to the design of the novel biped humanoid robot system, a control platform is provided; the system relates to the fields of control science and intelligent control in addition to robotics, and is capable of meeting the requirements of scientific research and teaching of a plurality of disciplines.

The invention provides a mapping method applied to humanoid robot double-hand motion imitation. The mapping method comprises the steps that positions of double shoulders, double elbows, double knees and a head of a human body in a world coordinate system are obtained, and corresponding target motions of double arms, double legs, a trunk and the head of a humanoid robot are calculated by utilizinga rotation matrix; the posture of human hands in the world coordinate system is obtained through a VR game handle and is converted into the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system; and the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system is the same as humanoid robot hand target posture RhandJ of the robot relative to the coordinate system, the RhandJ is decomposed into humanoid robot wrist posture RwristA and humanoid robot forearm posture RarmJ, a value expressed by an XYZ euler angle corresponding to the RwristA is taken as a target value of a humanoid robot wrist driving device, and human body wrist rotation is made to be accurately mapped to humanoid robot wrists.

Controlling interactions between real robots in a real environment and virtual robots in a virtual environment, wherein the interactions depend on positions of the real robots in the real environment and positions of the virtual robots in the virtual environment. Real robots may be represented by avatars eg. humanoid character, group of figures. Robots may be toys for entertainment or part of an interactive video game eg. role-playing game. Real robot behaviour may be modified – eg. changing speed or motion direction – in response to interaction with virtual robot, eg. collisions in racing games, combat in fighting games. Real and virtual robot actions may mirror or compliment each other. Sensor data from either the real or virtual robot may be used to control actions of the other robot. Real robots may comprise a camera to map and navigate, eg. using simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Virtual objects and robots may be superimposed on displayed images of the real environment. Real or simulated robots may be user controlled. Real robots may be powered by an inductive charging loop or solar panels. Robots may communicate with each other. LED or LCD display elements may provide visual feedback on robot status.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot attitude estimation method based on physical information constraint. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an attitude estimation network model; step 2, constructing a loss function; step 3, training the attitude estimation network model, and then performing attitude estimation by using the attitude estimation network model; step 4, calculating a state prediction value and a covariance matrix thereof; 5, calculating a gain matrix of the attitude estimation network model; step 6, calculating a posteriori estimation value of the state and a covariance matrix of the state; 7, calculating the state estimation result to obtain the joint posture estimation of the humanoid robot at the current moment; and step 8, repeatedly executing the step 4 to the step 7 to obtain attitude estimation results at all moments. The structure driven by the hybrid model can effectively avoid the conditions that the network model has large demand on annotation data and is easy to fall into local optimum and the like, and can provide an accurate attitude estimation result.

The invention discloses a wheel-foot type humanoid robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and is characterized in that a robot head is arranged on a robot main body and can be used for visual perception; the tool magazine is arranged on the robot main body and is used for storing operation tools and a hand driving wheel with a hub motor; the two mechanical legs are arranged on the robot body, and leg driving wheels with hub motors are arranged at the foot ends of the mechanical legs. The two mechanical arms are arranged on the robot body, and quick-change connectors are installed at the tail ends of the mechanical arms. In the two-wheel-foot state, the ends of the leg driving wheels on the two mechanical legs are supported on the ground; in the four-wheel-foot form, the circumferential faces of the leg driving wheels on the two mechanical legs are supported on the ground, the two mechanical arms are provided with the hand driving wheels through the quick-change connectors, and the wheel-foot type robot bends to enable the circumferential faces of the hand driving wheels at the tail ends of the mechanical arms to be also supported on the ground. According to the wheel-foot type humanoid robot, the moving and operating capabilities of the humanoid robot are enhanced.

The invention relates to a shopping robot and relates to the technical field of robots. The shopping robot comprises an armrest, a photographing device, a connecting rod, a machine body, a robot hand,an electric box, a seat, a shopping box and a chassis walking mechanism, wherein the photographing device is mounted on the armrest; the armrest is fixedly connected with the machine body through theconnecting rod; the machine body, the electric box and the shopping box are mounted on the chassis walking mechanism; the chassis walking mechanism is composed of two driving motors, two driving wheels, two steering universal wheels and a gear transmission mechanism. The shopping robot provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that a consumer issues an instruction to the robot throughintelligent communication equipment; after the robot receives the instruction, the robot transports the consumers to a commodity storage place; when commodities are purchased, the robot hand also canstretch and retract to grasp the commodities and put same into the shopping box so that the labor intensity of the consumers is greatly reduced and the comfort of shopping is improved.

According to the present invention, a humanoid robot is formed between a lower limb and an upper limb to minimize an impact and vibration, and comprises a series elastic actuator formed to manually and actively control the upper limb and the lower limb. The upper limb and the lower limb can be actively controlled by using a rotational force of a drive motor. The upper limb and the lower limb can be manually controlled in accordance with a force applied between the upper limb and the lower limb by means of an independent spring arranged inside a housing.

A reconfigurable controller base for a robotic arm is provided. In one aspect, a robotic system includes a base supporting one or more articulating links, the base comprising: a main housing comprising an external structure that at least partly encloses an inner portion of the main housing, the external structure forming an opening at a back side and a bottom side of the main housing, a reconfigurable bracket configured to be removably attached to the external structure of the main housing in at least two configurations to cover the opening at the back and bottom sides of the main housing, and a controller mounted on the bracket and arranged within the inner portion of the main housing in each of the at least two configurations of the bracket, the controller configured to control actuation of the one or more articulating links.

A neurosurgical robot navigation and positioning system and method are disclosed. The system comprises: a motion executing device(101), a spatial position sensor(102), an equipped position marker unit(103) and a computer device(104); wherein the computer device(104) is connected to the motion executing device(101) and the spatial position sensor(102), and configured to create a surgery plan on a digital graphic image, the surgery plan comprising a lesion position which is precisely self-targeted and a motion path thereof; the spatial position sensor(102) is configured to capture the equipped position marker unit(103) such that the computer device(104) implements position mapping between different spatial coordinate systems; and the motion execution device(101) is mounted with a surgical instrument(111), and configured to generate a specific motion scheme according to the lesion position which is precisely self-targeted and the motion path thereof and the position mapping between the different spatial coordinate systems, precisely self-target a lesion position, and securely lock the surgical instrument(111) to support a surgical operation.

A finger joint transmission structure of an anthropomorphic robot hand includes a first finger segment and a second finger segment that are pivotally connected to each other. A toothed rack in an arc shape is provided at the joint of the first finger segment and the second finger segment. The second finger segment has a speed reducer and a motor connected to the speed reducer therein. The speed reducer has a transmission shaft extending toward the toothed rack. A transmission gear meshing with the toothed rack is provided on the transmission shaft. When the motor drives the transmission shaft to rotate via the speed reducer, the transmission gear is synchronously driven to move along the toothed rack, so that the second finger segment is driven to be pivoted upward or downward at a predetermined angle relative to the first finger segment.

An all-terrain mobile robot comprising a mobile robotic platform, having either wheels or tank-treaded-like legs capable of navigating over rough terrain, wherein the robotic platform utilizes dynamic balancing behavior; a hydraulic powered anthropomorphic torso and articulated arms, wherein the hydraulic system possesses a pressure sensor for enabling the anthropomorphic torso and articulated arms to lift a payload using acute and delicate movements that reduce the chance of causing structural harm to the payload.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot object interaction method guided by a diffusion model based on key frames. Comprising the following steps: S1, generating interaction between a human body and an object based on a diffusion model of a key frame; s2, guiding the humanoid robot to interact with the object based on the contact instruction; and S3, interaction between the humanoid robot and the object based on the action generation guidance. According to the method, in an action generation stage, key frames of a robot and an object within a period of time are predicted according to a current state, a motion sequence is recovered by using interpolation, and then a universal robot and object interaction strategy is finely adjusted based on a generated and simulated closed-loop structure and a fixed diffusion model weight. The interaction strategy is rewarded due to accurate simulation of aligned movement and contact information and successful object control, the gap between the output of the diffusion model and the training data set of the simulation environment is made up, and the reward does not need to be designed for a specific task.

The present invention relates to a humanoid robot performing boxing. The humanoid robot according to the present invention is optimized in a boxing game by increasing destructive power when performing a punch and relieving impact when being punched. The present invention includes an upper body in which a head unit is mounted on the upper end; a lower body connected to the lower part of the upper body to be able to rotate; an arm unit formed with a plurality of individually operated joints and mounted on both sides of the upper body; and a leg unit formed with the individually operated joints and mounted on the lower end of the lower body; and a control unit controlling rotation between the upper body and the lower body, operation of the joints in the arm unit, and the operation of the joints in the leg unit.

The present invention relates to a multi-legged robot which comprises: a body; a plurality of legs provided on the body; a rail extended toward the outside of the body from a rear part of the body and provided with a gear on an outer circumference thereof; and a counter weight moving along the rail. The counter weight comprises: a weight; a first actuator placed on the weight; and a driving gear meshing with the gear and moving along the gear while rotating by the first actuator. The present invention provides a multi-legged robot which well utilizes a space inside the body and makes the body compact.

The invention discloses a self-walking robot. The self-walking robot comprises a radar device and a robot body, the radar device comprises a light-transmitting cover body, a first optical assembly, a second optical assembly and a driving assembly, and the first optical assembly and the second optical assembly are arranged in the light-transmitting cover body; the driving assembly drives the first optical assembly and the second optical assembly to rotate around the rotating shaft; the light-transmitting cover body comprises a first light-transmitting area and a second light-transmitting area, an assembling part is arranged on the machine body, and the radar device is assembled on the machine body through the assembling part; the assembling part is provided with a first avoiding opening, and the first light-transmitting area communicates with the outer portion of the front side of the machine body through the first avoiding opening. The first optical assembly and the second optical assembly are integrally arranged on the driving assembly, and the radar device is assembled on the assembly part of the machine body, so that the total height of the machine body is not increased too much, and good trafficability of the self-walking robot is guaranteed.

The invention relates to an indoor explanation system based on a humanoid robot and a method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot. The method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot comprises the steps that the robot calibrates a corresponding explanation position point through an explanation route of the robot, and after the robot arrives at the explanation position, corresponding infrared sensing module sends out request in a request receiving mode when the robot moves to the position of a corresponding infrared sensing module; and after the robotreceives the request of the corresponding infrared sensing module, the robot starts to adjust the position of the robot and then carries out corresponding scene explanation. Compared with the prior art, the method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot has the advantages that the working pressure of an explainer is reduced, it is guaranteed that the explaining is clear and accurate, the movement position of the robot is mastered in all directions, and the movement position of the robot is more accurate during explaining.

The present disclosure relates to a snake arm robot, which includes: a base disk; a rotary unit rotatably connected to the base disk and having multiple sub-disks sequentially arranged in a predetermined arrangement direction and rotatably connected to each other; a wire connector having multiple wires connected to the base disk or a plurality of disks selected from the sub-disks and sequentially disposed in the arrangement direction or disposed to partially face each other in a circumferential direction of the sub-disks; and a wire operator operating the wires to rotate the sub-disks by a predetermined angle.According to the snake arm robot of the present disclosure, since wires connected to disks to rotate the disks are arranged in a similar type to the muscle structure of a nematode, there is the advantage that rigidity and payload are increased.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot motion control device capable of performing a plurality of tasks simultaneously such as a motion balance maintenance and an arm working.

SOLUTION: A task and a condition of constraint imposed on a legged robot according to a motion condition are given by an equality and an inequality concerning variations dx from the present condition, and a driving strategy of redundant flexibility is defined as an energy function. It is not necessary to constitute a control system specialized for each condition of constraint for the change of the condition of constraint, but by only changing matrices A and C, and vector b, d, the change of the condition of constraint can be coped with. Therefore, various and dynamic condition of constrains are easy to handle. Moreover, only by changing matrix W and vector u, a using process of the redundant flexibility can be coped with.
