An extensible task engine framework for humanoid robots. Robot instructions are stored as tasks and skills. Tasks are designed so that they can be executed by a variety of robots with differing configurations. A task can refer to zero or more skills. A skill can be designed for a particular configuration of robot. A task can be transferred from robot to robot. When executed on a particular robot, the task makes calls to one or more skills that can take advantage of the capabilities of that robot.

The invention provides a hip and waist joint structure and a humanoid robot. The hip and waist joint structure comprises a waist support, a waist driving assembly arranged in the middle of the waist support and two hip driving assemblies arranged on the two sides of the waist support correspondingly; the hip driving assembly comprises a hip side module, a hip side transmission assembly, a hip rotation module and a hip front module which are fixedly connected to the waist support, the hip side transmission assembly is used for connecting the rotation movement end of the hip side module and the hip rotation module, and the rotation movement end of the hip rotation module is connected with the hip front module. According to the hip and waist joint structure and the humanoid robot, part of modules of the hip driving assembly are located at the waist joint, and the overall mass center of the hip driving assembly is increased. According to the leg structure, the hip side module is located at the transmission front end of the hip joint through the hip side transmission assembly, the hip rotation module only needs to drive the hip front module to rotate, the rotational inertia is small, the hip side module and the hip rotation module can be located at the waist joint, and the overall mass of the leg structure is reduced.

The invention provides a parallel leg structure for a legged robot capable of running at a high speed, relating to a parallel leg structure. The parallel leg structure provided by the invention solves the problem of relatively large energy consumption of the existing legged robot capable of running at a high speed because of the movement rule of periodic acceleration and deceleration. Two joint leg loading and hoisting steel plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on outer walls of two sides of a scapula; the upper end of a thigh is articulated with the lower part of the scapula; the lower end of the thigh is articulated with the upper end of a shank; a sole is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the shank; a parallel short connecting rod is articulated with the upper part of the thigh; the other end of the parallel short connecting rod is articulated with the upper end of a parallel long connecting rod; a horizontal valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is installed on the scapula and is horizontally arranged; a hydraulic rod of the horizontal valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is connected with the articulated point of the parallel short connecting rod and the parallel long connecting rod; a vertical valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is installed on the scapula and is vertically arranged; and a hydraulic rod of the vertical valve controlled hydraulic cylinder is connected with the articulated point of the parallel short connecting rod and the parallel long connecting rod. The parallel leg structure provided by the invention is used for the legged robot.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method, which comprises the following steps of: sensing user behaviors by adopting multiple sensors, constructing a multi-layer interactive situation sensing structure, and establishing association between a human-computer interaction situation and the user behaviors; self-adaptive layered isolated word recognition and voice emotion recognition based on an optimized neural network are adopted, user voice features are fully utilized, a matching relation between user emotion and robot situational social action emotion is constructed, and an emotion-fused robot situational social behavior expression decision is provided. Therefore, the multi-modal social behavior expression of the humanoid robot, which can express emotions while implementing an interaction task, is realized. According to the method, the relationship between the user behavior and the interaction situation and the relationship between the interaction situation and the social behavior of the humanoid robot are constructed, the problem that in the prior art, the emotion interaction is less when the humanoid robot executes the social task is solved, and the environment situation and the user emotion are fully considered; and a multi-situation social expression realization path of the humanoid robot is provided.

The invention provides a natural language control method for a humanoid robot. By constructing the simple skill library and the complex skill library of the robot, the dependence on a large amount of operation data in a specific field is effectively reduced. According to the method, a large language model is used as a base of a task planner, and the capabilities of scene learning, semantic understanding and common sense reasoning of the task planner are brought into full play. By introducing a visual model in the field of computer vision, high-level semantic information and low-level spatial information of the environment can be obtained, and an accurate scene graph is constructed to serve as environment state representation. According to the voice interaction interface constructed by the invention, the naturalness of man-machine interaction is improved, so that a user can more conveniently communicate with the robot and input instructions, the user experience is effectively improved, and popularization of the humanoid robot in an actual application scene is facilitated.

The invention discloses a heavy-load robot balancing load device setting method. The method comprises the steps that a heavy-load robot is set; the total load m borne by the three-axis small arm is obtained; a balance load device is arranged, a balance load m1 is obtained, and the torque generated by the balance load m1 and the torque generated by the total load m are opposite in direction; in an initial state, obtaining a total gravity center O'and a distance L, and measuring a total load included angle alpha; obtaining a balance gravity center O ''and a distance L1, and measuring a balance included angle beta; and starting from the initial state, rotating the heavy-load robot by a rotation angle X, obtaining peak values of the motor torque N3 at different balance included angles beta, comparing the peak values of the motor torque N3 at different balance included angles beta, selecting the corresponding balance included angle beta when the peak value of the motor torque N3 is minimum, and balancing the position of the gravity center O ''according to the balance included angle beta. Compared with the prior art, the method for setting the balancing load device of the heavy-load robot has the advantages that the motor torque can be reduced, and the light weight of the robot is realized.

The invention provides a mechanical thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. Wherein the mechanical thumb comprises a hinge seat, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, and the hinge seat is used for being rotationally connected with a palm structure of the dexterous hand around a first axis; the first knuckle comprises a knuckle shell and a first driving assembly arranged in the knuckle shell, and the knuckle shell and the hinge seat are rotationally connected around a second axis; the second knuckle is rotationally connected with the knuckle shell around a third axis; the first driving assembly is used for driving the knuckle shell to rotate around a second axis and driving the second knuckle to rotate around a third axis; the second axis and the third axis are both spatially intersected with the first axis, so that the mechanical thumb realizes three-degree-of-freedom movement, a more complex and natural action track can be generated, the action of a real thumb is simulated, and the action simulation degree is improved; the knuckle shell integrates the transmission function and the appearance shell, the first driving assembly is arranged in the inner space of the shell, the protection effect is achieved, and the appearance simulation degree of the mechanical thumb is improved.

The invention discloses a humanoid robot which comprises a sliding plate and a humanoid robot body; the humanoid robot body comprises two leg parts which can swing in a crossed manner, and two foot parts which are arranged on the bottoms of the two leg parts which can swing in the crossed manner; the two foot parts are detachably arranged on the sliding plate; a drive control system is arranged in the sliding plate; a control system for controlling motion of the humanoid robot is arranged inside the humanoid robot body; the control system is connected to the drive control system in a wired manner or a wireless manner for sending a control instruction of controlling the motion of the sliding plate to the drive control system; and the drive control system is used for receiving the control instruction and driving the motion of the sliding plate according to the control instruction. The humanoid robot solves the problem that a double-foot travelling type robot, a crawler type robot, a roller type robot and a robot with a double-foot travelling type structure have respective defects for different terrains in the prior art, and can be adaptive to the different terrains to select proper motion modes.

The invention provides an efficient path planning method based on scene understanding and an AMR robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a standard transportation path of a material transportation task, carrying out the material transportation task according to the standard transportation path, determining an occurrence place of a traffic retardation event when the traffic retardation event is detected in a material transportation process, and carrying out the execution of the material transportation task according to the determined occurrence place. Performing congestion scene analysis on the occurrence place of the traffic blocking event, and judging whether the traffic blocking event is a path congestion event according to a congestion scene analysis result, the path congestion event being that the current transportation path cannot pass, the method comprises the following steps of: when an event that materials cannot be delivered to a target location within a time limit required range is detected, or the passing time is too long, and when the passing blocking event is a path blocking event, re-executing transportation path planning on the material transportation task, so that the reliability and timeliness of material transportation in a hospital can be fully ensured, and the transportation efficiency of the hospital is improved. And efficient and reliable material transportation capability support is provided for each functional module of a hospital.

The invention discloses an anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged. The anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged comprises an upper half body frame, mechanical supporting arms, a seat integrated device, a lower half body frame, a half body lifting device, a wheelbase increasing device, a displacement power device and a control system; two groups of mechanical supporting arms are arranged; the two groups of mechanical supporting arms are rotationally connected to the left side and the right side of the upper half body frame; the seat integrated deviceis connected to the bottom of the upper half body frame; the bottom of the upper half body frame is connected with the lower half body frame through the half body lifting device; and the upper half body frame can lift under the action of the half body lifting device; the wheelbase increasing device is used for increasing the stability of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged; the displacement power device realizes the movement of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged; and the control system realizes automatic control of the walking assisting robot accompanying the aged.The anthropomorphic walking assisting robot accompanying the aged has the characteristics of high safety, walking assistance, flexible movement and the like, and solves the faced difficulty of the aged in daily life.

Methods and systems are disclosed for efficient and accurate planning of multi-object robotic grasping operations. Such methods and systems allow for implementation of the concept of “only-pick-once”, in which multiple objects are picked by a robotic grasping mechanism according to a grasping plan. A picking plan for a robotic picking arm may be generated according to a desired picking characteristic (e.g., a number of objects per grasp, a goal of minimizing grasping actions, etc.). Sensor data indicative of a work environment may be used to generate a graph relating objects of interest. The objects may be clustered according to various attributes or connections, such as whether a group of objects is within the maximum grasping area of the robotic arm or collision avoidance. The clusters may be ranked, then a picking plan determined for picking clusters by ranking.

The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing a strategy network which comprises an input layer, two serial circulation hidden layers, and a linear output layer; designing a reward function; then, based on a reward function, a mujoo simulation platform is used for training the constructed strategy network, the posture and the terrain of the robot are initialized, and different footstep sequences are preset for different terrains; updating the policy network by using a PPO algorithm; and carrying out motion control on the humanoid machine by utilizing the trained strategy network. Under the condition that a target footstep sequence is known, cross-terrain stable walking is realized through a strategy network and a sliding window observation mechanism, and closed-loop control from environmental understanding to action generation is realized; the designed reward function can effectively guide the robot to form stable and natural gait behaviors, and the trained strategy network can be directly migrated to an actual robot platform.

The invention provides a humanoid robot and a multi-rotational-degree-of-freedom ankle joint thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a cross shaft, an ankle support. an ankle joint first transmission shaft and an ankle joint second transmission shaft, wherein the cross shaft comprises a first direction shaft and a second direction shaft which are perpendicular to each other, the first direction shaft is used for being rotatably mounted on a lower connecting part of a shank shaft, and the second direction shaft is a hollow shaft with a through hole; and the ankle support is provided with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is inserted into the through hole of the second direction shaft, so that the ankle support rotates around the second direction shaft. According to the ankle joint, two rotational degrees of freedom of the ankle joint or a foot can be realized, and a multi-direction swinging function at a simulated human ankle is realized by a relatively simple and innovatively designed structure.

The invention discloses an AR intelligent helmet device capable of achieving gesture interaction. The AR intelligent helmet device comprises an AR helmet and a gesture recognition module. Wherein the AR helmet is composed of a multi-camera module, an SoC computing board, a binocular micro display screen and an optical machine module, the multi-camera module collects gesture images, gesture action control instructions are recognized through gesture recognition processing on the SoC computing board based on the ARM + NPU architecture, function selection, clicking, quitting and page changing actions are carried out, and the gesture images are displayed through the binocular micro display screen and the optical machine module. The images are synchronously displayed on the binocular micro display screen and the ray machine module; the gesture recognition module runs on the SoC computing board and is used for carrying out hand detection and static gesture recognition on the gesture images collected by the multi-camera module, and a hand detection network based on RetinaHand is adopted for hand detection. Compared with the prior art, the method can achieve gesture interaction recognition, has the advantages of being short in time delay, accurate in hand action recognition and capable of supporting real-time interaction, and has important significance in communication between people, between people and machines and even between humanoid intelligent machines.

The present approach relates to integrated planning of robot navigation and manipulator motion in performing tasks. In particular, as discussed herein sensor information, such as visual information, may be used for the robot to locate a target object when it arrives at a working location. Adjustments may be made based on this information that may include moving the robot and planning a manipulator arm motion.

The invention discloses a voice interaction method based on a public display device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining voice of a user by the public display device; converting the obtained voice of the user into corresponding character information; detecting whether the character information obtained through conversion includes a preset keyword or not to obtain a detection result; determining the intention of the user according to the obtained detection result; and performing interaction response on the user through the voice according to the determined intention of the user. By using the mode, the goals of determining the intention of the user by obtaining the voice of the user and doing the humanoid interaction of the voice response by the publicdisplay device can be achieved.

The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand based on space connecting rods and planetary gear trains, which comprises a palm, a thumb and four fingers, four groups of space connecting rod mechanisms are arranged on the palm and are correspondingly in driving connection with the four fingers, and the freedom degree of bending and side swaying of the fingers is realized; a transversely-arranged miniature electric cylinder is installed at the bottom of the palm, and the miniature electric cylinder drives the thumb to achieve the freedom degree of palm swing through a gear and rack assembly. According to the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand, a space connecting rod mechanism and a planetary gear train mechanism are introduced, and the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand has the advantages of being high in degree of freedom, small in size, reasonable in structural design, high in coupling precision and stable in coupling force.

The invention discloses a robot non-singular hand-eye calibration method based on a sequential rotation mechanism, relates to the technical field of visual calibration and robots, analyzes a hand-eye calibration analytic solution method based on modified Rodrigues parameters proposed by R.Y.Tsai, discovers inherent defects for the first time, and provides a method for calibrating the robot non-singular hand-eye calibration based on the R.Y.Tsai and the robot non-singular hand-eye calibration based on the R.Y.Tsai. Comprising the following steps: a user performs a virtual rotation motion on a rotation axis akBi of RBi obtained by actual measurement according to own preference, a corresponding rotation matrix is marked as Ruser, and at the moment, a vector group akBi is changed into Ruser kBi; and as long as the user matrix Ruser is properly selected, the rotation angle value of the rotation matrix determined by the measurement vector group {kAi, Ruser kBi} is no longer equal to the pi radian. According to the method, the inherent defects of hand-eye calibration analytic solutions proposed by R.Y.Tsai based on similar parameters are well overcome, and the safety and robustness of the transformer substation inspection robot hand-eye calibration analytic solution method based on modified Rodrigues parameters are improved to a certain extent.

The object of the invention is a humanoid robot (100) with a body (190) joined to an omnidirectional mobile ground base (140), equipped with : - a body position sensor, a base position sensor and an angular velocity sensor to provide measures, - actuators (212) comprising at least 3 wheels located in the omnidirectional mobile base, - extractors (211) for converting sensored measures into useful data, - a supervisor (500) to calculate position, velocity and acceleration commands from the useful data, - means for converting commands into instructions for the actuators, characterized in that the supervisor comprises: - a no-tilt state controller (501), a tilt state controller (502) and a landing state controller (503), each controller comprising means for calculating, position, velocity and acceleration commands based on a double point-mass robot model with tilt motion and on a linear model predictive control law, expressed as a quadratic optimization formulation with a weighted sum of objectives, and a set of predefined linear constraints.

The invention relates to a rigid-flexible coupling type back assisting backpack structure for an exoskeleton robot. The backpack structure is characterized by comprising a back armor, an artificial spine part and a back frame part, wherein the back armor is fixed to the back of a human body, the left part and the right part of the back armor are used for being connected with the back frame part, and the middle part of the back armor is used for being connected with the artificial spine part; the artificial spine part comprises a back armor main board, a back armor auxiliary board, a spine section upper fixing box, a spine section upper fixing shaft, a spine section uppermost section, spine sections, a spine section lowermost section, a spine section lowermost section fixing plate and pneumatic tendons; and the back frame part comprises a plurality of flexible chains, the back frame, guide rails, a pulley fixing plate and a pulley, the plurality of flexible chains are sequentially connected, and every two adjacent flexible chains can rotate relative to each other. According to the structure, the pneumatic tendons and the spine sections of the artificial spine part can help people torealize the back assistance function, and the artificial spine part has a length-adjustable function and can be adapted to people with different heights, so that the structure is more suitable for being worn by the human body and convenient to operate.

PURPOSE: A charge cradle device of quadruped robot is provided to embody the movement test of a quadruped robot while charging by freely moving four legs of a quadruped robot with picking up from the floor. CONSTITUTION: A charge cradle device of quadruped robot an upside placing portion(110), a chargeable power terminal(120), a settlement detecting unit(130), a power circuit substrate(140), a cradle main body(150) and an external power connector(160). The upper side of the upside placing portion is formed according to the shape of the belly of a quadruped robot. The chargeable power terminal is touched with the charging terminal of a quadruped robot and provides the charging power. The settlement detecting unit detects the settlement of a quadruped robot. The power circuit substrate provides the charging power to the quadruped robot through the chargeable power terminal. The cradle main body has the height and width enough for four legs of the quadruped walking robot to move freely. The external power connector connects the external power to the power circuit substrate.

A system may include two character figurines, each of which may be an action figure. Each character figurine may have a body with a humanoid shape. The character figurines may include a first character figurine with a wireless transmitter that transmits a wireless signal, and a second character figurine with a wireless receiver that receives the wireless signal. The second character figurine may have an action system that causes the second character figurine to undertake a visually perceptible action when the wireless signal is received. The action system may include a motor, and the visually perceptible action may include motion of the second character figurine, driven by the motor, that approximates receipt of a wound inflicted by the first character figurine.

Belonging to the technical field of anthropomorphic robots, an underactuated modularized anthropomorphic robot hand device with crossed tendons is similar to a human hand, the structures of an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger are the same, each finger applies a motor to drive three joints to rotate, the palm applies a motor to drive the root of the thumb to sway sidewise and rotate, and the thumb applies a motor to drive two joints to rotate. The device has five independently controlled fingers, fifteen joint freedom degrees, six driving joints and nine underactuated joints; the underactuated joint of each finger applies a crossed tendon and gear transmission mechanism with the same or approximate structure, a socketed middle finger section and a spring part with a multi-joint decoupling function, so, not only is the cost reduced, but also maintenance is convenient; the motors and the transmission mechanisms are hidden into the hand, the structure is simple, the weight is light, control is easy, and the degree of integration is high; the appearance, size and motion of the whole device imitate a human hand, and the device can automatically grasp objects with different shapes and sizes.

The invention discloses a double-arm motion planning method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps that according to a kinematic model of a left arm and a right arm of the humanoid robot, forward kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly, and on the basis of the forward kinematic equations, inverse kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; according to the inverse kinematic equations, the quadratic programming problem expressions of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; and then quadratic programming indexes of the left arm and the right arm are combined with a constraint to obtain a standard quadratic programming problem expression of the humanoid robot; three motion planning judgment methods of the humanoid robot are set according to the standard quadratic programming problem expression; and thethree motion planning judgment methods are combined to resolve the standard quadratic programming problem expression, and the optimal solution is output. According to the method, the left arm and theright arm of the humanoid robot which can be controlled is well completed; and the double-arm motion planning method of the humanoid robot has the characteristics of being clear in mind, strong in logicality, simple and clear, effective, and the like.

The invention discloses a shank structure, a lower limb assembly, a robot, a biped robot and a humanoid robot, the shank structure comprises a shank provided with a first mounting cavity and a second mounting cavity penetrating in the thickness direction of the shank, a first mounting seat arranged on one side of the shank, and a second mounting seat arranged on the other side of the shank; the first mounting seat is provided with a third mounting cavity and a fourth mounting cavity; the second mounting seat is arranged on the other side of the shank, a fifth mounting cavity and a sixth mounting cavity are formed in the second mounting seat, the third mounting cavity and the fifth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the first mounting cavity, and the fourth mounting cavity and the sixth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the second mounting cavity. Therefore, the area, occupied by the first foot joint module and the second foot joint module, of the shank body can be reduced, the radial size of the shank can also be reduced, and the situation that large space of the shank in the radial direction is occupied can be avoided.

The invention discloses a multi-foot-wheel walking robot which comprises a vehicle body, a steering unit and a multi-foot-wheel mechanism. The vehicle body comprises a main vehicle frame, an auxiliaryvehicle frame and a control room; the steering unit comprises a fixed plate, a steering motor and a steering driving gear; and the multi-foot-wheel mechanism comprises a fixed seat, a mounting seat,an eccentric shaft, a driving gear, a driven gear, a planet wheel disc, a foot rod, a foot rod mounting seat, a hinge shaft, a connecting piece and a steering driven gear. The multi-foot-wheel walkingrobot has the beneficial effects that the control is simple in the walking process of the robot, the passing capacity is good, and the practicability is high.

A system for wirelessly operating an end effector and a robotic arm of a robotic assembly includes a remote control having a sensor for generating movement data corresponding to a movement of the remote control by a user, and a primary switch operable to commence a logging of spatially defined points present in the generated movement data. The system also includes a receiver in wireless communication with the remote control, a processor communicably coupled to the receiver, and a controller communicably coupled to the processor, the memory, and an actuator associated with the robotic assembly. The receiver receives the movement data from the sensor. The processor logs the spatially defined points in a memory in response to the primary switch being actuated. The controller commands the actuator for initiating movement of at least one of the robotic arm and the end effector based on the logged spatially defined points.

Various surgical systems are disclosed. A surgical system comprises a robotic system. The robotic system comprises a control unit; a robotic arm comprising an attachment portion; a first sensor system in signal communication with the control unit; and a second sensor system. The first sensor system is configured to detect a position of the attachment portion. A surgical tool is removably attached to the attachment portion. The second sensor system is independent of the first sensor system and is configured to detect a position of the surgical tool.

The invention provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises a small arm assembly, the small arm assembly comprises a small arm, a wrist framework, a first wrist joint driving piece and a second wrist joint driving piece, the small arm is provided with an elbow joint end and a wrist joint end, and the first wrist joint driving piece, the wrist framework, the second wrist joint driving piece and the wrist joint end are sequentially connected. The first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially arranged in the axial direction of the forearm, the first wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the hand assembly to rotate around a first reference axis, and the second wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the wrist skeleton to rotate around a second reference axis; the first reference axis, the second reference axis and the axis of the small arm are perpendicular to one another. According to the mechanical arm, the mode that the first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially connected in series is adopted to replace a traditional motor parallel connection and connecting rod transmission matching scheme, the structure of the small arm assembly is simplified, and the weight of the mechanical arm is reduced.

The invention discloses a virtual character voice regulation and control method and device and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: determining an initialized voice parameter after a virtual character is activated according to environment voice, and feeding back an initialized voice to a user according to the initialized voice parameter; acquiring a second demand voice which is sent by a user and is associated with the first demand voice, and adjusting the first voice content, the first voice tone, the first voice volume and the first voice orientation according to the second voice content, the second voice tone, the second voice volume and the second voice orientation in the second demand voice, and generating and outputting a second feedback voice associated with the first feedback voice. According to the invention, a humanized virtual character voice regulation and control scheme is realized, so that the interaction between the virtual character and the user has a more humanoid feeling, the efficiency of voice interaction between the user and the virtual character is improved, and the use experience of the user is enhanced.
